axis: respectful address for an old woman → old woman rendered ugly and evil

members.tone: A way of speaking to an old woman rather than a way of describing her, and it lends her the standing of kin in the act of addressing her.
Puts menace behind the ugliness - she does not just look evil, she looks capable of it, which is the charge *hag* leaves off.
Repulsion with nothing added: the same ugly, evil-looking figure as *witch* but stripped of any power, so it jeers where *witch* recoils.
A diminutive fastened to any old woman at all, grandmother or not - familiar where *mother* is deferential, and it shrinks her to her age.
